capabilities: count words and characters via the installed Microsoft Word desktop app
show detailed statistics (characters, paragraphs, lines, pages, Asian characters) in a status bar hover panel
export the current note to DOCX with configurable fonts, spacing, indentation, and punctuation
cache per-note statistics and mark stale results after edits instead of launching Word on every keystroke
extras: Windows 10/11 and Obsidian desktop 1.5.0+ only; interface and commands are currently in Chinese (with English command names); uses local PowerShell/COM automation with filesystem and shell permissions and makes no network requests; the listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's built-in word count differs from Microsoft Word's counting, which matters when manuscripts must be measured and delivered in Word terms.

relations.evidence: Count words with the Microsoft Word desktop app and export Markdown notes to DOCX.

summary: Status bar word counter that uses the local Microsoft Word desktop app to compute statistics and export the current note as a DOCX file.
